Asawa Food Products (Zoff Spices).note: Asawa Food Products (operating as Asquare Foods and Beverages / Zoff Foods) was co-founded by brothers Akash and Ashish Agrawal and remains an independent company backed by venture funding from JM Financial and Aman Gupta.

Chotelal Masalawala.note: Chotelal Masalawala operates as a self-owned enterprise under Clappers Seasonings & Spices LLP and has no recorded history of acquisition.

Dhani Pure Spices Private Limited.note: The brand Dhani Pure Spices is owned and operated by its parent entity, Freshtech Foods Private Limited, and remains an active, unfunded independent business with no record of acquisition.

Gajanand Foods Private Limited.note: Gajanand Foods Private Limited is a self-owned company founded by Shri Natvarbhai Patel and continues to operate as an active company under family management.

Harihar Foods Pvt. Ltd..note: The company operates independently under its original founding family management and has not been acquired.

K-Pra Foods Private Limited.note: K-Pra Foods Private Limited continues to operate independently under its original founding family management and has not been acquired by another company.

Lifespice India Private Limited.note: The company operates independently under its original promoters, led by Lead Promoter and Managing Director Ganeshan Varadarajan.

Mahashian Di Hatti Private Limited.note: The company officially denied rumors of a majority stake acquisition by Hindustan Unilever Limited in 2022 and remains independently operated by its founding family.

Munimji Food Products Private Limited.note: The business operates actively under Munimji Foods and Spices Private Limited and its parent group Pushp Brand (India) Limited, owned by the Surana family with minority backing from institutional investors.
Munimji Food Products Private Limited.current_name: Munimji Foods and Spices Private Limited

Om Oil & Flour Mills Ltd.note: The company was founded in 1976 by Sarat Kumar Sahoo and continues to operate independently as the owner of the Ruchi Spices brand.

Sresta Natural Bioproducts Private Limit.note: ITC Limited completed the 100% acquisition of the company in June 2025.
